mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases for 3 consecutive months.
